verses.original: לְדָוִ֨ד׀ רִיבָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה אֶת־ יְרִיבַ֑י לְ֝חַ֗ם אֶת־ לֹֽחֲמָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ḏā·wiḏ rî·ḇāh Yah·weh ’eṯ- yə·rî·ḇay lə·ḥam ’eṯ- lō·ḥă·māy
verses.literal: Of David Contend with my opponents O LORD . . . fight against those . . . who fight against me
verses.literalPt: Contende, Jeová, com os que comigo contendem; peleja contra os que contra mim pelejam.

verses.original: הַחֲזֵ֣ק מָגֵ֣ן וְצִנָּ֑ה וְ֝ק֗וּמָה בְּעֶזְרָתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ha·ḥă·zêq mā·ḡên wə·ṣin·nāh wə·qū·māh bə·‘ez·rā·ṯî
verses.literal: Take up Your shield and buckler arise and come to my aid
verses.literalPt: Toma o escudo e o pavês e levanta-te em meu auxílio.

verses.original: וְהָ֘רֵ֤ק חֲנִ֣ית וּ֭סְגֹר לִקְרַ֣את רֹדְפָ֑י אֱמֹ֥ר לְ֝נַפְשִׁ֗י יְֽשֻׁעָתֵ֥ךְ אָֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·rêq ḥă·nîṯ ū·sə·ḡōr liq·raṯ rō·ḏə·p̄āy ’ĕ·mōr lə·nap̄·šî yə·šu·‘ā·ṯêḵ ’ā·nî
verses.literal: Draw the spear and javelin against my pursuers say to my soul I am your salvation
verses.literalPt: Tira da lança e embarga o passo aos que me perseguem. Dize à minha alma: Eu sou a tua salvação.

verses.original: יֵבֹ֣שׁוּ וְיִכָּלְמוּ֮ מְבַקְשֵׁ֪י נַ֫פְשִׁ֥י יִסֹּ֣גוּ אָח֣וֹר וְיַחְפְּר֑וּ חֹ֝שְׁבֵ֗י רָעָתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: yê·ḇō·šū wə·yik·kā·lə·mū mə·ḇaq·šê nap̄·šî yis·sō·ḡū ’ā·ḥō·wr wə·yaḥ·pə·rū ḥō·šə·ḇê rā·‘ā·ṯî
verses.literal: May those who seek my life be disgraced and put to shame may those who plan to harm me be driven back . . . and confounded
verses.literalPt: Sejam envergonhados e cobertos de desonra os que buscam tirar-me a vida; sejam obrigados a voltar atrás e sejam confundidos os que tramam fazer-me o mal.

verses.original: יִֽהְי֗וּ כְּמֹ֥ץ לִפְנֵי־ ר֑וּחַ וּמַלְאַ֖ךְ יְהוָ֣ה דּוֹחֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: yih·yū kə·mōṣ lip̄·nê- rū·aḥ ū·mal·’aḵ Yah·weh dō·w·ḥeh
verses.literal: May they be like chaff in the wind as the angel of the LORD drives them away
verses.literalPt: Sejam como a moinha diante do vento, acossando-os o anjo de Jeová.

verses.original: יְֽהִי־ דַרְכָּ֗ם חֹ֥שֶׁךְ וַחֲלַקְלַקּ֑וֹת וּמַלְאַ֥ךְ יְ֝הוָ֗ה רֹדְפָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: yə·hî- ḏar·kām ḥō·šeḵ wa·ḥă·laq·laq·qō·wṯ ū·mal·’aḵ Yah·weh rō·ḏə·p̄ām
verses.literal: May their path be dark and slick as the angel of the LORD pursues
verses.literalPt: Torne-se o seu caminho escuro e escorregadio, perseguindo-os o anjo de Jeová.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ חִנָּ֣ם טָֽמְנוּ־ לִ֭י שַׁ֣חַת רִשְׁתָּ֑ם חִ֝נָּ֗ם חָפְר֥וּ לְנַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ḥin·nām ṭā·mə·nū- lî ša·ḥaṯ riš·tām ḥin·nām ḥā·p̄ə·rū lə·nap̄·šî
verses.literal: For without cause they laid their net for me without reason they dug a pit for my soul
verses.literalPt: Pois, sem causa, esconderam para mim um laço; sem causa, abriram para a minha alma uma cova.

verses.original: תְּבוֹאֵ֣הוּ שׁוֹאָה֮ לֹֽא־ יֵ֫דָ֥ע וְרִשְׁתּ֣וֹ אֲשֶׁר־ טָמַ֣ן תִּלְכְּד֑וֹ בְּ֝שׁוֹאָ֗ה יִפָּל־ בָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: tə·ḇō·w·’ê·hū šō·w·’āh lō- yê·ḏā‘ wə·riš·tōw ’ă·šer- ṭā·man til·kə·ḏōw bə·šō·w·’āh yip·pāl- bāh
verses.literal: May ruin befall them by surprise . . . may the net they hid ensnare them may they fall into the hazard they created
verses.literalPt: Venha sobre ele a destruição, quando menos pensa; apanhe-o o próprio laço que escondeu. Nele caia para a sua destruição.

verses.original: וְ֭נַפְשִׁי תָּגִ֣יל בַּיהוָ֑ה תָּ֝שִׂישׂ בִּישׁוּעָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nap̄·šî tā·ḡîl Yah·weh tā·śîś bî·šū·‘ā·ṯōw
verses.literal: Then my soul will rejoice in the LORD and exult in His salvation
verses.literalPt: A minha alma exultará em Jeová, regozijar-se-á na sua salvação.

verses.original: כָּ֥ל עַצְמוֹתַ֨י׀ תֹּאמַרְנָה֮ יְהוָ֗ה מִ֥י כָ֫מ֥וֹךָ מַצִּ֣יל עָ֭נִי מֵחָזָ֣ק מִמֶּ֑נּוּ וְעָנִ֥י וְ֝אֶבְי֗וֹן מִגֹּזְלֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kāl ‘aṣ·mō·w·ṯay tō·mar·nāh Yah·weh mî ḵā·mō·w·ḵā maṣ·ṣîl ‘ā·nî mê·ḥā·zāq mim·men·nū wə·‘ā·nî wə·’eḇ·yō·wn mig·gō·zə·lōw
verses.literal: All my bones will exclaim Who is like You O LORD who delivers the afflicted from the aggressor the poor and needy from the robber
verses.literalPt: Todos os meus ossos dirão: Jeová, quem é semelhante a ti, que livras o pobre daquele que é mais forte do que ele; o pobre e o necessitado, do que o despoja?

verses.original: יְ֭קוּמוּן עֵדֵ֣י חָמָ֑ס אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־ יָ֝דַ֗עְתִּי יִשְׁאָלֽוּנִי׃
verses.transliteration: yə·qū·mūn ‘ê·ḏê ḥā·mās ’ă·šer lō- yā·ḏa‘·tî yiš·’ā·lū·nî
verses.literal: Hostile witnesses come forward they make charges I know nothing about
verses.literalPt: Levantam-se testemunhas injustas; sobre coisas que ignoro, me interrogam.

verses.original: יְשַׁלְּמ֣וּנִי רָ֭עָה תַּ֥חַת טוֹבָ֗ה שְׁכ֣וֹל לְנַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.transliteration: yə·šal·lə·mū·nî rā·‘āh ta·ḥaṯ ṭō·w·ḇāh šə·ḵō·wl lə·nap̄·šî
verses.literal: They repay me evil for good to the bereavement of my soul
verses.literalPt: Tornam-me o mal pelo bem, o que é um esbulho para a minha alma.

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֤י׀ בַּחֲלוֹתָ֡ם לְב֬וּשִׁי שָׂ֗ק עִנֵּ֣יתִי בַצּ֣וֹם נַפְשִׁ֑י וּ֝תְפִלָּתִ֗י עַל־ חֵיקִ֥י תָשֽׁוּב׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·nî ba·ḥă·lō·w·ṯām lə·ḇū·šî śāq ‘in·nê·ṯî ḇaṣ·ṣō·wm nap̄·šî ū·ṯə·p̄il·lā·ṯî ‘al- ḥê·qî ṯā·šūḇ
verses.literal: Yet when they were ill I put on sackcloth I humbled myself with fasting but my prayers returned unanswered . . .
verses.literalPt: Mas, quanto a mim, estando eles enfermos, era o saco a minha vestidura; eu afligia a minha alma com jejum. A minha oração, porém, voltou para o meu seio.

verses.original: כְּרֵֽעַ־ כְּאָ֣ח לִ֭י הִתְהַלָּ֑כְתִּי כַּאֲבֶל־ אֵ֝֗ם קֹדֵ֥ר שַׁחֽוֹתִי׃
verses.transliteration: kə·rê·a‘- kə·’āḥ lî hiṯ·hal·lā·ḵə·tî ka·’ă·ḇel- ’êm qō·ḏêr ša·ḥō·w·ṯî
verses.literal: I paced about as for my friend or brother I was bowed down with grief like one mourning for his mother
verses.literalPt: Portava-me como se fora o meu amigo ou meu irmão; eu ia curvado em pranto, como quem chora por sua mãe.

verses.original: וּבְצַלְעִי֮ שָׂמְח֪וּ וְֽנֶאֱ֫סָ֥פוּ נֶאֶסְפ֬וּ עָלַ֣י נֵ֭כִים וְלֹ֣א יָדַ֑עְתִּי קָֽרְע֥וּ וְלֹא־ דָֽמּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·ṣal·‘î śā·mə·ḥū wə·ne·’ĕ·sā·p̄ū ne·’es·p̄ū ‘ā·lay nê·ḵîm wə·lō yā·ḏa‘·tî qā·rə·‘ū wə·lō- ḏām·mū
verses.literal: But when I stumbled they assembled in glee they gathered together against me Assailants I did not know slandered me without ceasing
verses.literalPt: Mas, quando tropecei, eles se regozijaram e se ajuntaram; ajuntam-se contra mim, injuriando-me por motivos que ignoro; dilaceram-me e não cessam:

verses.original: בְּ֭חַנְפֵי לַעֲגֵ֣י מָע֑וֹג חָרֹ֖ק עָלַ֣י שִׁנֵּֽימוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ḥan·p̄ê la·‘ă·ḡê mā·‘ō·wḡ ḥā·rōq ‘ā·lay šin·nê·mōw
verses.literal: Like godless jesters at a feast they gnashed their teeth at me
verses.literalPt: Como vis bufões nos festins, rangem contra mim os dentes.

verses.original: אֲדֹנָי֮ כַּמָּ֪ה תִּ֫רְאֶ֥ה הָשִׁ֣יבָה נַ֭פְשִׁי מִשֹּׁאֵיהֶ֑ם מִ֝כְּפִירִ֗ים יְחִידָתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·ḏō·nāy kam·māh tir·’eh hā·šî·ḇāh nap̄·šî miš·šō·’ê·hem mik·kə·p̄î·rîm yə·ḥî·ḏā·ṯî
verses.literal: How long O Lord will You look on Rescue my soul from their ravages my precious life from these lions
verses.literalPt: Senhor, por quanto tempo estarás olhando? Livra a minha alma das suas violências; dos leões, a minha predileta.

verses.original: א֭וֹדְךָ בְּקָהָ֣ל רָ֑ב בְּעַ֖ם עָצ֣וּם אֲהַֽלְלֶֽךָּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ō·wḏ·ḵā bə·qā·hāl rāḇ bə·‘am ‘ā·ṣūm ’ă·hal·le·kā
verses.literal: Then I will give You thanks in the great assembly I will praise You among many people
verses.literalPt: Dar-te-ei graças na grande congregação; entre muito povo te louvarei.

verses.original: אַֽל־ יִשְׂמְחוּ־ לִ֣י אֹיְבַ֣י שֶׁ֑קֶר שֹׂנְאַ֥י חִ֝נָּ֗ם יִקְרְצוּ־ עָֽיִן׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- yiś·mə·ḥū- lî ’ō·yə·ḇay še·qer śō·nə·’ay ḥin·nām yiq·rə·ṣū- ‘ā·yin
verses.literal: Let not my enemies gloat over me without cause nor those who hate me without reason wink in malice . . .
verses.literalPt: Não se regozijem injustamente sobre mim os meus inimigos, nem pisquem o olho os que, sem causa, me odeiam.

verses.original: כִּ֤י לֹ֥א שָׁל֗וֹם יְדַ֫בֵּ֥רוּ וְעַ֥ל רִגְעֵי־ אֶ֑רֶץ דִּבְרֵ֥י מִ֝רְמוֹת יַחֲשֹׁבֽוּן׃
verses.transliteration: kî lō šā·lō·wm yə·ḏab·bê·rū wə·‘al riḡ·‘ê- ’e·reṣ diḇ·rê mir·mō·wṯ ya·ḥă·šō·ḇūn
verses.literal: For they do not speak peace but they devise deceitful schemes against those who live quietly in the land
verses.literalPt: Pois não falam paz, mas tramam enganos contra os que estão quietos sobre a terra.

verses.original: וַיַּרְחִ֥יבוּ עָלַ֗י פִּ֫יהֶ֥ם אָ֭מְרוּ הֶאָ֣ח׀ הֶאָ֑ח רָאֲתָ֥ה עֵינֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yar·ḥî·ḇū ‘ā·lay pî·hem ’ā·mə·rū he·’āḥ he·’āḥ rā·’ă·ṯāh ‘ê·nê·nū
verses.literal: They gape . . . at me and say Aha aha Our eyes have seen
verses.literalPt: Escancararam contra mim a boca; disseram: Ainda bem! Ainda bem! Os nossos olhos o viram.

verses.original: רָאִ֣יתָה יְ֭הוָה אַֽל־ תֶּחֱרַ֑שׁ אֲ֝דֹנָ֗י אֲל־ תִּרְחַ֥ק מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
verses.transliteration: rā·’î·ṯāh Yah·weh ’al- te·ḥĕ·raš ’ă·ḏō·nāy ’ăl- tir·ḥaq mim·men·nî
verses.literal: O LORD You have seen it be not silent O Lord be not far from me
verses.literalPt: Tu os viste, Jeová; não fiques calado; Senhor, não te afastes de mim.

verses.original: הָעִ֣ירָה וְ֭הָקִיצָה לְמִשְׁפָּטִ֑י אֱלֹהַ֖י וַֽאדֹנָ֣י לְרִיבִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: hā·‘î·rāh wə·hā·qî·ṣāh lə·miš·pā·ṭî ’ĕ·lō·hay wa·ḏō·nāy lə·rî·ḇî
verses.literal: Awake and rise to my defense to my cause my God and my Lord
verses.literalPt: Acorda e desperta para o meu julgamento, para a minha causa, Deus meu e Senhor meu.

verses.original: שָׁפְטֵ֣נִי כְ֭צִדְקְךָ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָ֗י וְאַל־ יִשְׂמְחוּ־ לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: šā·p̄ə·ṭê·nî ḵə·ṣiḏ·qə·ḵā Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hāy wə·’al- yiś·mə·ḥū- lî
verses.literal: Vindicate me by Your righteousness O LORD my God and do not let them gloat over me
verses.literalPt: Julga-me, Jeová, Deus meu, segundo a tua retidão; e não se regozijem eles sobre mim.

verses.original: אַל־ יֹאמְר֣וּ בְ֭לִבָּם הֶאָ֣ח נַפְשֵׁ֑נוּ אַל־ יֹ֝אמְר֗וּ בִּֽלַּעֲנֽוּהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- yō·mə·rū ḇə·lib·bām he·’āḥ nap̄·šê·nū ’al- yō·mə·rū bil·la·‘ă·nū·hū
verses.literal: Let them not say in their hearts Aha just what we wanted Let them not say We have swallowed him up
verses.literalPt: Não digam eles em seu coração: Ainda bem! Cumpriu-se o nosso desejo. Não digam eles: Nós o devoramos.

verses.original: יֵ֘בֹ֤שׁוּ וְיַחְפְּר֨וּ׀ יַחְדָּו֮ שְׂמֵחֵ֪י רָעָ֫תִ֥י יִֽלְבְּשׁוּ־ בֹ֥שֶׁת וּכְלִמָּ֑ה הַֽמַּגְדִּילִ֥ים עָלָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: yê·ḇō·šū wə·yaḥ·pə·rū yaḥ·dāw śə·mê·ḥê rā·‘ā·ṯî yil·bə·šū- ḇō·šeṯ ū·ḵə·lim·māh ham·maḡ·dî·lîm ‘ā·lāy
verses.literal: May those who gloat in my distress be ashamed and confounded . . . may those who exalt themselves over me be clothed in shame and reproach
verses.literalPt: Sejam envergonhados e confundidos juntamente os que se regozijam com o meu mal; cubram-se de vergonha e de ignomínia os que se engrandecem contra mim.

verses.original: יָרֹ֣נּוּ וְיִשְׂמְחוּ֮ חֲפֵצֵ֪י צִ֫דְקִ֥י וְיֹאמְר֣וּ תָ֭מִיד יִגְדַּ֣ל יְהוָ֑ה הֶ֝חָפֵ֗ץ שְׁל֣וֹם עַבְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: yā·rōn·nū wə·yiś·mə·ḥū ḥă·p̄ê·ṣê ṣiḏ·qî wə·yō·mə·rū ṯā·mîḏ yiḡ·dal Yah·weh he·ḥā·p̄êṣ šə·lō·wm ‘aḇ·dōw
verses.literal: May those who favor my vindication shout for joy and gladness may they always say Exalted be the LORD who delights in His servant’s well-being
verses.literalPt: Cantem de júbilo e se alegrem os que têm prazer na minha retidão; digam continuamente: Seja magnificado Jeová, que se deleita na prosperidade do seu servo!

verses.original: וּ֭לְשׁוֹנִי תֶּהְגֶּ֣ה צִדְקֶ֑ךָ כָּל־ הַ֝יּוֹם תְּהִלָּתֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·šō·w·nî teh·geh ṣiḏ·qe·ḵā kāl- hay·yō·wm tə·hil·lā·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: Then my tongue will proclaim Your righteousness and Your praises all day long
verses.literalPt: A minha língua celebrará a tua justiça e o teu louvor durante o dia todo.
